claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament airs on CBS, ESPN, and Prime Video.
Streaming for the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on Masters.com, the Masters App, and Paramount+.
Prime Video covers early-round action from 1–3 p.m. ET on Thursday and Friday.
ESPN covers early-round action from 3–7:30 p.m. ET on Thursday and Friday.
CBS and Paramount+ provide weekend coverage.
The Masters app and Masters.com offer free coverage including Amen Corner, featured groups, and holes 15 & 16.
Prime Video covers 1–3 p.m. ET on April 9-10.
ESPN covers 3–7:30 p.m. ET on April 9-10.
Paramount+ provides early coverage on April 11-12.
CBS provides afternoon coverage on April 11-12.
Featured Groups and holes are available throughout the day on April 11-12 on Masters.com, Masters App, Paramount+, and Prime Video.
ESPN+/ESPN App covers early rounds and exclusive feeds.
Prime Video is a new broadcaster covering 1-3 p.m. ET on Thursday and Friday.
FuboTV offers access to CBS and ESPN.
